# Owner profile seed

## Purpose and import boundary

This template is generated and maintained by the setup agent from the seven-answer private intake, environment discovery and facts learned during real work. The owner should not manually complete a second questionnaire.

It records stable, owner-approved facts that help the agent work well across future sessions.

It is not a biography, task list, project tracker, credential store, private-data dump or permission grant. Review every completed field before importing it through the supported owner-profile workflow. Keep the completed private copy outside the public repository.

Do not guess, infer or complete missing facts from social profiles, email, calendars, browser history or prior conversations. Learn unknowns only when a real task requires them.

Never store passwords, tokens, cookies, recovery codes, MFA seeds, private keys, payment details, raw account exports, private chat history or temporary task status here.

---

## Owner-approved identity

- Display name: `{{OWNER_OR_COMPANY_NAME}}`
- Preferred form of address: `[OWNER_FORM_OF_ADDRESS]`
- Timezone: `Setup agent discovers and verifies from the recipient environment`
- Pronouns, if the owner wants them recorded: `<optional>`
- Primary language: `<owner-confirmed or unknown>`
- Other working languages: `<optional>`
- General location relevant to work: `<city/region/timezone only when needed>`

Identity fields describe the owner. They do not authorize account access, impersonation, commitments or external action.

## Working relationship

Record only owner-approved descriptions:

- Agent role: `<for example: operating partner, chief of staff, research assistant>`
- What the owner wants help with on day one: `[OPTIONAL_HELP_AND_PROJECTS]`
- Further stable working preferences are learned during real tasks and recorded only after confirmation.

The agent should reduce repetition and routine coordination without treating the owner as a technical operator for internal agent mechanics.

## Communication preferences

- Owner-approved communication style: `[COMMUNICATION_STYLE]`
- Default decision pattern: explanation first, recommendation, then a real picker when needed.
- Additional stable preferences may be learned during real work and recorded only after owner confirmation.

The agent should state what happened, what evidence exists and what remains. It should not use false reassurance, invented certainty or process narration as a substitute for progress.

## Decision and approval boundaries

The following default boundaries remain in force unless an approved, documented workflow grants narrower standing authority:

- Safe local research, organization, drafting, indexing and testing may proceed when the request is clear.
- Public posting, publishing, live sending and external commitments require approval.
- Purchases, payments, refunds, donations, advertising spend and subscriptions require approval.
- Production changes, deployment, account creation, account recovery, permission changes and credential changes require approval.
- Destructive deletion, replacing originals and broad data export require approval.
- Legal, medical, financial, employment, safeguarding and individual-impact decisions require qualified human review.
- Authentication authority does not grant downstream action authority.

Owner-specific standing authorities:

- `<confirmed workflow and exact boundary, or none>`
- `<confirmed workflow and exact boundary, or none>`

Hard stops:

- `<owner-confirmed prohibited action>`
- `<owner-confirmed prohibited data class>`

## Accessibility, language and inclusion

Record stable preferences only when relevant:

- Reading or visual-access needs: `<confirmed or unknown>`
- Caption, transcript or alt-text preference: `<confirmed or unknown>`
- Person-first or identity-first language preferences: `<confirmed by the person/organization>`
- Cultural, religious or identity considerations the owner explicitly wants respected: `<optional>`
- Required human review areas: `<confirmed>`

Do not infer disability, diagnosis, identity, legal status or support needs. Sensitive details belong in an approved restricted source, not a general owner profile.

## Organizations, projects and relationships

Store only stable routing facts, not private histories:

- Primary organization or business: `<confirmed name and role, or unknown>`
- Other durable organizations: `<confirmed>`
- Long-lived project families: `<confirmed names only>`
- Key collaborators and relationship: `<only when needed and approved>`
- Final approvers by domain: `<confirmed role, not inferred authority>`

Detailed project state belongs in the project hub. Contact records belong in the approved contact system. Sensitive personnel, customer, beneficiary, donor, patient, student or family details do not belong here.

## Knowledge, files and task visibility

- Knowledge source of truth: `<approved Brain OS or knowledge root>`
- Code source of truth: `<approved Git host/organization>`
- Original-file source of truth: `<approved cloud or exact-file store>`
- Owner-visible task source: `<approved task hub>`
- Calendar/email/cloud platform: `<provider only; no account identifiers unless necessary>`
- Naming conventions: `<stable owner preference>`
- Filing conventions: `<stable pointer to the owning procedure>`

Do not copy full notes, project records, account exports or file inventories into this profile.

## Confirmed unknowns

Unknown means not yet approved or not yet needed. Do not guess:

- Preferred working hours: `<unknown until needed>`
- Scheduling rules: `<unknown until needed>`
- Writing voice: `<unknown until examples are approved>`
- Active accounts and authorized identities: `<use the access registry>`
- Financial authority: `<unknown unless explicitly documented>`
- Publication authority: `<unknown unless explicitly documented>`
- Retention requirements: `<unknown until the relevant workflow is designed>`
- Model/provider budget: `<unknown until selected>`

These are not an onboarding questionnaire that must be completed all at once. Learn them naturally and record only durable, useful facts.

## Review and maintenance

Before importing this profile:

- [ ] Every populated fact was confirmed by the owner or an owner-authoritative source.
- [ ] No credential, secret, recovery material or private account export is present.
- [ ] No temporary task, deadline, project status or completed-work log is present.
- [ ] No speculative biography, inferred relationship or sensitive case detail is present.
- [ ] Approval boundaries are explicit and do not conflict with system policy.
- [ ] Unknowns remain marked unknown rather than guessed.
- [ ] The private completed copy is stored outside public source.

Review after major life, organization or authority changes. Replace stale facts instead of appending contradictions. Project and task updates belong in durable project/task sources, not this file.
